balance.def: The rest of the stay cost after the reservation fee. The guest pays it, with the security deposit, at least one day before check-in.

brownout.def: A planned power cut announced by the power company. The team charges the EcoFlow the day before and keeps the emergency light ready.

cassy.def: The digital assistant of Cascade Hideaway. She answers guests on Messenger and helps staff in Telegram. From Telegram she never sends anything to a guest.

concierge.def: The guest side of Cassy on Messenger. She answers questions and takes bookings, and she passes anything difficult to the host.

confirm-and-leave.def: The last checks in Phase 4 of the Cleaner app: door lock, power and water, meter readings, and the utensil set. The utensil set is asked only on a turnover or a deep clean.

deep-clean.def: A longer, fuller clean of the unit that is done now and then, not after every guest. It has its own choice in the Cleaner app.

deposit.def: The PHP 1,000 refundable security deposit on a direct booking. It is paid with the balance and is returned after the check-out inspection finds no problem. Airbnb bookings carry no cash deposit.

digest.def: The short morning card the system posts in the OPS group at 08:00. It lists arrivals, departures and anything that needs care that day. On a quiet day it stays silent.

draft.def: A reply that Cassy suggests for a guest message. A draft is only text for you to copy. Nothing is sent to the guest until a person sends it.

dwell-time.def: The waiting time for cleaning products to work on a surface. The Cleaner app has a timer for it in Phase 2, from 5 to 20 minutes.

ecoflow.def: A battery power station that stays in the unit. It keeps the important things running during a power cut. It is house equipment, not something a guest can borrow.

finance-group.def: The Telegram group for Lloyd and Marifel. Money cards, payment receipts and expense entries appear here.

handoff.def: A guest request that Cassy cannot settle alone, so she passes it to the host. It appears as a card in the OPS group until someone answers it.

heartbeat.def: The small sign that each automatic job leaves after it runs. If a heartbeat is missing for too long, the system posts a card saying a scheduled job has stopped.

hold.def: The dates kept for a guest for 24 hours while the guest sends the reservation fee. If nothing is paid in that time, the hold is released and the guest owes nothing.

inquiry.def: A direct booking request from the booking site or Messenger that is not confirmed yet. It becomes a booking when the payment is checked and confirmed.

ledger.def: The official record of money in and money out. Confirmed expenses and income are written here.

mapped-staff.def: A person whose Telegram account is linked to a staff profile. Some buttons, such as Confirm booking, work only for mapped staff. If a button says your account is not mapped, ask Lloyd.

meter-skip.def: The Cleaner app lets you skip a meter photo now and then, but never two in a row. If the app will not let you skip, take the photo.

mid-stay.def: A clean during a guest's stay, not after check-out. It has its own choice in the Cleaner app.

notice.def: A dated item on the operations board, such as a brownout, a holiday, an event or a reminder. Notices appear in the morning digest.

ops-group.def: The Telegram group for the whole team, including cleaners. It carries alerts, cleaning reports and guest hand-offs. It never shows money.

promo.def: A temporary discount on the nightly price. It is set on the Pricing page of the dashboard and ends on a date.

rate-card.def: The one stored list of nightly prices. The booking site and Cassy both read it, so a price is changed in one place only.

reservation-fee.def: 50 percent of the stay, paid to secure the dates once the payment is checked. It is fully refunded when the guest cancels 5 or more days before check-in.

stay-picker.def: The list in Phase 0 of the Cleaner app where you choose which guest stay this cleaning belongs to.

supply-log.def: The pop-up in Phase 3 of the Cleaner app where you record the supplies you used. You must save it before you can go on to Phase 4.

turnover.def: The full clean of the unit after a guest checks out, to get it ready for the next guest.

verifier.def: The automatic system check. It looks every hour for problems such as two stays on the same nights, and posts a card only when something is wrong.

work-order.def: A repair or fix task. An urgent note from a cleaner becomes a work order, and it is closed in the dashboard when the job is done.

system-of-record.def: The database behind the dashboard. It is the official record of bookings, guests, cleaning reports, stock and money. Cards and e-mails are only messages about it.

receipt.def: The screenshot or photo that proves a payment. A guest sends it to confirm a booking, and staff post receipt photos of purchases in the Finance group.
